wordlist_file.description: Absolute path to the primary file containing banned words (one word per line).

action.description: Behavior when a banned word is detected in a message. 'block' rejects the message, 'replace' substitutes the word, 'warn' logs a warning but allows delivery.

replacement.description: String used to replace banned words when action is 'replace'.

exempt_users.description: List of JIDs (full or partial globs) of users exempt from filtering (e.g., server admins).

items.description: A user JID or glob pattern (e.g., 'admin@example.com' or '*@admin.*')

case_insensitive.description: If true, banned words are matched regardless of case.

partial_match.description: If true, banned words match even when embedded inside other words (e.g., 'bad' matches 'badly'). Enable with caution.

log_blocked.description: If true, messages blocked due to banned words are logged (requires ejabberd logging to be enabled).

additional_wordlists.description: Additional file paths whose banned words are appended to the main wordlist.

items.description: Absolute path to an extra banned words file.
